headword: {国立公園|こくりつこうえん}

definitions.explanation: A protected area of natural beauty or ecological significance designated and managed by the national government. Japan has 34 national parks as of 2024.

examples.japanese: {日光|にっこう}は{国立公園|こくりつこうえん}に{指定|してい}されている。
examples.english: Nikko is designated as a national park.

examples.japanese: {国立公園|こくりつこうえん}の{中|なか}では{動植物|どうしょくぶつ}の{採取|さいしゅ}が{禁止|きんし}されている。
examples.english: Collecting plants and animals is prohibited within national parks.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}の{休暇|きゅうか}に{家族|かぞく}で{国立公園|こくりつこうえん}を{訪|おとず}れ、ハイキングや{野鳥|やちょう}{観察|かんさつ}を{楽|たの}しんだ。
examples.english: During the summer holidays, we visited a national park as a family and enjoyed hiking and birdwatching.

notes:
USAGE:
{国立公園|こくりつこうえん} combines {国立|こくりつ} (national) + {公園|こうえん} (park). Japan also has {国定公園|こくていこうえん} (quasi-national parks) managed at the prefectural level with national oversight.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国立公園|こくりつこうえん}に{指定|してい}する (to designate as a national park)
- {国立公園|こくりつこうえん}を{訪|おとず}れる (to visit a national park)
- {国立公園|こくりつこうえん}{内|ない} (within the national park)
